help.threadloop:
Usage: threadloop [options] [command]

Task-first, repo-local session memory that generates review-ready artifacts

Options:
  -V, --version       output the version number
  -h, --help          display help for command

Commands:
  init                Initialize ThreadLoop in the current Git repo
  artifact            Generate artifacts from session context
  session             Manage explicit ThreadLoop sessions
  executor            Run the frozen GAAP reference process bridge
  audit               Inspect and export the authoritative audit ledger
  workflow            Manage graph-bound Workflow Runs
  protocol [options]  Print the agent integration protocol
  help [command]      display help for command
help.init:
Usage: threadloop init [options]

Initialize ThreadLoop in the current Git repo

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command
help.artifact generate:
Usage: threadloop artifact generate [options] [kind]

Generate a Markdown artifact from task, notes, and Git context

Arguments:
  kind            artifact kind (default: "change-brief")

Options:
  --session <id>  session id to target
  --json          Output machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help      display help for command
help.session start:
Usage: threadloop session start [options] <title>

Start a task-scoped session

Arguments:
  title                         task title

Options:
  --goal <goal>                 goal for the task
  --constraint <constraint...>  constraints that matter for this task
  --base <ref>                  base Git ref used for comparisons; defaults to
                                main when available
  --issue <ref>                 issue reference for branch and PR traceability
  --actor <actor>               entry actor for the initial intent record
                                (default: "cli")
  --goal-edit                   open $EDITOR for the goal text
  --run-config <file>           caller configuration and snapshot file paths for
                                immutable audit attribution
  --json                        Output machine-readable JSON
  -h, --help                    display help for command
